knowledge_units.content: Separate provider catalog/discovery/runtime ownership from the coding harness.
Single-owner provider generations/leases are a useful pattern for safe replacement, drain and shutdown.
Local-only admin surfaces should validate loopback client plus Host/Origin, not rely on localhost placement alone.
Code-session persistence with explicit state transitions and SQLite transactions is a useful reference pattern.
Provider-specific smoke/E2E plus progressive-startup tests are useful acceptance patterns.
Automatic fallback exists upstream but is not adopted as global Tupiniquim behavior.

knowledge_units.content: Agent state machine, bounded step budget and stuck-loop detection are useful patterns.
Explicit plan-step states improve observability and recovery.
Tool catalog should be explicit; unknown tool dispatch should fail closed.
MCP tool schemas may change dynamically; refresh/diff can detect added/removed/changed tools, but execution remains under local policy.
Sandbox managers benefit from per-sandbox locks, global creation limits, idle timeout and guaranteed cleanup.
Use defense-in-depth across network/stateful controls, workload/cloud firewall, reverse proxy/API gateway and WAF as appropriate.
Use modern library-backed cryptography; TLS for transport; AEAD for application encryption when required; do not default new systems to legacy 3DES/Blowfish.
Prefer phishing-resistant MFA/passkeys/hardware keys for higher-risk accounts when supported; scope and expire tokens; separate authentication from authorization.
Threat models should consider insider, external, physical, human error, supply chain, credential, network, application, cloud and IoT risks as relevant.
Operational classification should center authorization/scope/capability/impact, not hat-color labels; offensive testing requires explicit authorization.
API Gateway and rate limits are useful layers for request abuse, but volumetric DDoS requires upstream/edge protection too.
A non-sensitive deterministic canary can detect context/session loss, but repository/checkpoint/database state remains the source of truth.
